en.headline: Customs arrest yoga centre director over alleged wrongful payment
en.dek: One company director was arrested on Friday as Hotstone Yoga complaints rose to 286, involving more than HK$3.9 million.
body: Customs arrested a company director on Friday in a special operation targeting alleged unfair trade practices at a yoga centre, after Hotstone Yoga was reported to have closed all of its studios. The department said the man was suspected of wrongly accepting payment, an offence under the Trade Descriptions Ordinance. He has been arrested and has not been charged in the reports available on Friday evening.

The Consumer Council said that by 5pm it had received 286 complaints related to Hotstone Yoga, involving more than HK$3.9 million. That is a sharp rise from the 27 complaints Customs were reported to be examining on Thursday, when the chain shut its studios after a sudden notice to customers.

The council said customers who paid a deposit or the full amount by credit card or another method with a chargeback mechanism should contact their card issuer quickly to ask whether a refund is available, and should note that chargeback deadlines can be short. Instalment payments by card may not be covered.

If a liquidator has been appointed, the council said consumers can register as creditors, but they would generally rank as unsecured creditors behind employees, the government and secured creditors. If a business closes because it cannot pay its debts, the chance of customers recovering money is not high, the council said. It advised people signing service contracts to insist that what is promised is written down, including cancellation terms, and to keep receipts.

zh.headline: 海關拘捕瑜伽中心一名公司董事　疑不當地接受付款
zh.dek: 岩盤浴瑜伽全線結業後，海關星期五拘捕一名公司董事，消委會接獲286宗投訴，涉款逾390萬元。
body: 海關星期五採取特別執法行動，打擊一間瑜伽中心的不良營商手法，拘捕一名公司董事。海關表示，該名男子涉嫌違反《商品說明條例》中「不當地接受付款」的罪行。截至星期五晚上的報道，他已被拘捕，尚未見提堂或落案起訴的消息。事件涉及提供瑜伽課堂的岩盤浴瑜伽Hotstone Yoga，該中心懷疑已全線結業。
消委會表示，截至下午5時，共接獲286宗相關投訴，涉款超過390萬元。星期四中心突然通知顧客結業時，海關正跟進的投訴約為27宗，數字在一日內大幅上升。
消委會表示，若消費者以信用卡或其他設有退款機制的方式支付按金或全數費用，應盡快聯絡發卡機構，查詢有關交易是否有退款保障，並留意退款申請或設期限，過期未必受理。以信用卡分期付款的消費者亦未必受惠。
消委會又指，若商戶已委任清盤人，消費者可登記為債權人，但一般只屬無抵押債權人，排在僱員、政府及有抵押債權人之後。若商戶因資不抵債結業，消費者最終取回款項的機會不高。消委會提醒，簽訂服務合約時應要求把服務內容、取消條款及已繳款項安排寫明，並保存合約及收據。
